newsitem.title: USA: Henry Schein to acquire Micro Bio-Medics.
newsitem.headline: Henry Schein to acquire Micro Bio-Medics.

text.p: Henry Schein Inc. said Friday it has agreed to acquire Micro Bio-Medics Inc., another provider of health care products and services to physicians, in a stock deal valued at $117 million.
The deal will probably make Henry Schein North America's largest distributor of health care products to office-based health care practitioners, it said.
Under the definitive agreement, Melville, N.Y.-based Schein will offer 0.62 of a share of its stock for each Micro share, or a total of about 3.1 million new shares.
The price is based on Schein's Thursday closing price of $28.50, and includes the assumption of Pelham Manor, N.Y.-based Micro's debt, stock options and warrants.
Schein edged up 12.5 cents to $28.625, while Micro was unchanged at $15.75 on Nasdaq on Friday.
Schein said it expected the deal to boost 1997 earnings, even though it will result in a one-time charge for the year.
The deal is expected to close by mid-1997, subject to approval by Micro shareholders.
